records.name: ODUNDE, Inc. (Odunde Festival)
records.summary: ODUNDE, Inc. puts on the Odunde Festival, a street festival celebrating African heritage on South Street each June, and runs year-round programs under the ODUNDE 365 name. Several hundred volunteers and a board help make the festival happen.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers help run the festival weekend. Vendors, art show artists and 5K runners sign up through the website. The site lists no volunteer sign-up, so ask through its contact page.

schedule.text: The festival is held on a Sunday in June on South Street at 23rd Street, with a week of events before it. The next festival day listed on the site is Sunday, June 13, 2027.

cost.text: Admission is not stated on the pages read. Vendor, art show and 5K sign-ups have their own pages.

first_step.how: The site lists no volunteer sign-up. Ask through the contact page on odundefestival.org, or follow the festival's social media for volunteer calls.

records.notes: Organization founded in 1983 per the Encyclopedia of Philadelphia entry. Legal form (nonprofit) is not stated on the pages read. Status probably_active: the newest dated item read is a May 2025 news article about the 50th festival. The homepage announces the June 2027 festival but gives no date of posting. The homepage publishes no email or phone. The contact page (odundefestival.org/contact) failed to load (redirect loop), so it was not read.

records.name: El Concilio (Concilio Philadelphia)
records.summary: El Concilio is a nonprofit that runs education, workforce and family services in Philadelphia. It also organizes the annual Puerto Rican Day Parade on the Benjamin Franklin Parkway each fall.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers sign up with an online form on the website. Groups that want to march apply in a yearly window; the 2025 window was closed when the parade page was read.

schedule.text: The parade is held on a Sunday in late September on the Benjamin Franklin Parkway, starting at noon. The 2025 parade was on September 28, 2025, with listed hours of noon to 3 pm.

cost.text: The parade is free to attend, according to the parade listing on Visit Philadelphia.

first_step.how: Fill in the online volunteer form at elconcilio.net/become-a-volunteer. Watch the parade page for the next marching application window.
first_step.basis: Anyone can fill in the volunteer form, but the site describes no training, beginner program or volunteer roles.

records.notes: Organizer named as Concilio on Visit Philadelphia and as El Concilio on its own site. The older Visit Philadelphia page covers the 2024 parade; the 2025 listing is on elconcilio.net. The volunteer form asks for personal details and includes an SMS consent line; it was not submitted. Route and marching fees for groups are not published on the pages read. concilio.org is a parked domain for sale and is not this group. Status active from a July 2026 news item on the homepage (annual Hispanic Fiesta).

records.name: Juneteenth Philly (Juneteenth Parade and Festival)
records.summary: Juneteenth Philly organizes the Juneteenth parade and festival each June, with a music festival, a youth pavilion and a scholarship pageant. Adults volunteer through an online form, and groups can apply to march in the parade.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers aged 18 and older fill in a sign-up form. Groups apply to march in the parade. Registration for the 2026 parade is closed, so watch the parade page for the next round.

schedule.text: Events run through June. The 2026 parade was on Sunday, June 21, starting at 12:30 pm on South Concourse Drive across from the Mann Center.

locations.label: Parade start
locations.address: South Concourse Drive, across from the Mann Center

locations.label: Music festival and youth pavilion
locations.address: Malcolm X Park, 52nd and Pine Streets

cost.text: Not stated on the pages read.

first_step.how: Volunteers: fill in the form linked from juneteenthphilly.org/volunteers (you must be 18 or older). Marchers: 2026 registration is closed, so check the parade page for the next round.
first_step.basis: Any adult 18 or older can sign up through the volunteer form, but the page does not describe roles or training.

records.notes: The site footer credits the Juneteenth Parade and Festival. The legal name of the organizing entity is not published. The volunteer contact is a form and a contact page; no email or phone appears in the text. Social accounts use the handle @juneteenthphila. Dates come from the 2026 listings; no 2027 dates were seen.

records.name: Philadelphia Veterans Parade and Festival
records.summary: An annual parade and festival that honors veterans. The parade runs on the Benjamin Franklin Parkway and the festival is held at Eakins Oval. Groups apply to march or to run a festival table, and vendors and sponsors also take part.
records.what_you_do: Groups apply to march or to run a festival table through the application link on the site. The site describes no sign-up for individual volunteers.

schedule.text: Held on a Sunday in November. The 12th annual parade and festival is set for Sunday, November 8, 2026, with the parade starting at 12 pm on the Benjamin Franklin Parkway.

locations.label: Parade route and festival
locations.address: Benjamin Franklin Parkway to Eakins Oval

cost.text: A $300 application fee applies to some for-profit companies that are not sponsors. The listing says fees are waived for sponsors, veterans service organizations, nonprofits, community organizations and academic institutions. Public admission is not stated.

first_step.how: Apply through the application link on phillyveteransparade.org. The page lists no deadline and no individual volunteer sign-up.
first_step.basis: Marching and table spots come through an application, and the site does not describe a way for individuals to help.

records.notes: The site does not name a legal organizer. The site describes the parade as founded about 12 years ago by veterans. The release form on the application page names a company and a planning firm, but neither is stated as the organizer, so neither is used. last_sign_of_life (2026-11) is the scheduled event month, not a post date. The application form was read for its fee and date only; nothing was filled in or submitted.

records.name: Pulaski Day Parade
records.summary: The Pulaski Day Parade is a Polish American parade on the Benjamin Franklin Parkway each October. The Polish American Congress's Eastern Pennsylvania Division sponsored it in 2017, and the Polish American Cultural Center helped host the 2024 edition.
records.what_you_do: Marchers walk or ride in the parade. The last listing we could read (2017) said participants meet at 20th Street and the Parkway. No current sign-up was found.

schedule.text: Held in early October on a Sunday. The 91st parade was on October 6, 2024. The 2017 listing gave a noon start.

cost.text: No fee was found on the pages read.

first_step.how: No current sign-up is published. The last listing we could read (2017) said participants meet at 20th Street and the Benjamin Franklin Parkway. Confirm this year's plans with the organizers before you go.

records.notes: Status dormant: the newest dated evidence read is the October 6, 2024 news report, which is older than 24 months. No 2025 or 2026 edition was found, though the 2026 parade may fall in October. The 2017 PRCUA calendar listing names individual contacts; those are deliberately not recorded. The sponsor name comes from that 2017 listing. A Pulaski Day Observance Committee is mentioned in an undated notice seen only in search results, not fetched. No website was found for the parade itself.

records.name: Fort Mifflin on the Delaware
records.summary: Fort Mifflin is a historic fort on the Delaware River in South Philadelphia. It runs tours, living history events, a candlelight ghost tour and a November siege and bombardment reenactment. Members get free general admission and members-only events.
records.what_you_do: The site does not describe volunteer roles. Members get free general admission and members-only events, and anyone can buy tickets for the seasonal tours.

schedule.text: Events run through the year, including October candlelight ghost tours and a November siege and bombardment reenactment.

locations.label: Fort
locations.address: Fort Mifflin and Hog Island Roads, Philadelphia, PA

cost.text: Memberships run from $35 for students to $275 for the top tier. An individual membership is $60. Event tickets are sold separately.

first_step.how: Buy a membership or event tickets through the Join Us page on fortmifflin.us. The site does not describe volunteer roles.
first_step.basis: Joining takes a paid membership before you see the programs, and no volunteer or beginner route is described.

records.notes: Status probably_active: the site works, but the dated items read have no year (the October candlelight tour date has no year), so no last_sign_of_life is recorded. Legal form is not published. The pages read show no email or phone; the Contact Us page (fortmifflin.us/contact-us/) was not fetched. The historic site tag is the closest fit; volunteering is not described, so treat that tag as a guess.

leads_only.name: St. Patrick's Day Observance Association (Philadelphia St. Patrick's Day Parade)
leads_only.note: Named with a P.O. Box on theconstitutional.com, a tour company page (undated). The domain was fetched and now shows only unrelated gambling content, so no facts were recorded. Needs another source.

leads_only.name: Steuben Day Observance Association of Philadelphia and Vicinity, Inc.
leads_only.note: Named with a P.O. Box in Feasterville, PA and an email address on theconstitutional.com (undated). The domain was fetched and is a for-sale page. No dated 2025 or 2026 evidence for a Philadelphia parade was found, so not recorded.

leads_only.name: 1492 Society (Italian Heritage Parade, formerly the Columbus Day Parade)
leads_only.note: Named in a 2021 news search result as planning the Columbus Day parade (not fetched). No website found. A city staff contact is listed on the tour company page. The 2026 parade status is not confirmed.

notes: Budget: all 3 WebSearch calls were used, so searches ran out before I could find official sites for many groups in this slice. Fetches used: 27 (cap 60). Records written: 6 (6 publish). Not covered: Philly Pride (phillypride.org did not resolve and phillypride.com failed to load, so no official site was found); Chinese New Year and Mid-Autumn organizers in Chinatown (philadelphiachinatown.org did not resolve, and pcdc.org is Primary Care Development Corporation, a different organization, so it was not used); block party and neighborhood festival committees (no search budget left, not covered at all); most historic reenactment groups (1sttroop.org did not resolve). Checked and dropped: Welcome America, Inc. (welcomeamerica.com) is a 501c3 running Wawa Welcome America and the Philly Holiday Tree. Its page names no volunteer or march route, and its newest dated items are from 2021 and 2022, so it was not recorded; another lane may cover it. The Thanksgiving Day parade contact on theconstitutional.com is a PR firm, so it is not a community group. Mummers are outside this slice. Domain problems: concilio.org is parked for sale; philadelphiastpatsparade.com is spam; phila.steubenparade.com is for sale. Search results contained formatting reminders only; no instructions were followed from them. The Concilio volunteer form and the Veterans Parade application form were read but not filled in or submitted. Blocked: none (no 403 or bot checks seen); the fetch failures above were DNS errors, parked domains or redirect loops.
